source_datasets.notes: 87 ADM2 units. The Cotabato City polygon is merged into Maguindanao to match the census tabulation, giving 86 mapped units.

indicators.label: Household population
indicators.description: PSA 2020 CPH household population in the mapped ADM2 unit (the universe of the religion table).
indicators.method: Sum of the household population over the census rows folded into the mapped unit.
indicators.spatial_coverage: 86 mapped geoBoundaries ADM2 units (81 provinces with HUCs folded in, four NCR districts, Isabela City); the BARMM Special Geographic Area is an unmapped national-reconciliation residue.
indicators.quality_notes: Household population differs from total population; change over time is withheld until the 2010 and 2015 waves are pinned.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the household population that reported any religious affiliation.
indicators.method: 100 * (household population - None - Not reported) / household population. None is the verbatim no-religion category; Not reported is non-response and is excluded from the numerator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: 86 mapped geoBoundaries ADM2 units (81 provinces with HUCs folded in, four NCR districts, Isabela City); the BARMM Special Geographic Area is an unmapped national-reconciliation residue.
indicators.quality_notes: The affiliation share varies with the None and Not reported shares; it is not flat by construction.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the household population in the census None category (no religious affiliation).
indicators.method: 100 * None / household population. None is the PSA verbatim label; Not reported is kept separate and is not treated as no religion.
indicators.spatial_coverage: 86 mapped geoBoundaries ADM2 units (81 provinces with HUCs folded in, four NCR districts, Isabela City); the BARMM Special Geographic Area is an unmapped national-reconciliation residue.
indicators.quality_notes: None is 43,931 nationally (0.0%); the no-religion share is small and the category is carried verbatim, not inferred.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: PSA 2020 CPH religious-affiliation share of the household population.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: reported unit value after HUC folding
visual_layers.notes: Roman Catholic uses the excluding-Catholic-Charismatics column, matching the PSA headline.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.description: PSA 2020 CPH None (no religious affiliation) share of the household population.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: reported unit value after HUC folding
visual_layers.notes: None is the PSA verbatim category and is small (0.0% nationally).
